summary: DNP3 module reaches T2 on the critical finding: dnp3_no_secure_auth. A plain FC1 g60v1 read succeeded — that is unauthenticated retrieval of live process telemetry, not just stance. Device-attribute extraction (g0 v240/242/243/250/252) is T0 vendor fingerprint. Unsolicited-response leak observes actual event data on connect (T1). Biggest gap: no attempt to send read-only FC1 g60v2/g30v* variants to exfil more telemetry, no g120 SA challenge probe (would positively confirm SA is disabled vs unsupported).

findings.title_pattern: DNP3 SCADA outstation reachable on the scanned network
findings.tier_evidence: Data-link 0x0564 sync + CRC-16-DNP verify + valid FC9 or FC1 reply is deterministic protocol match.
findings.promotion_notes: Stance; specific evidence covered by dnp3_no_secure_auth.

findings.title_pattern: DNP3 outstation accepts Read without Secure Authentication (IEEE 1815 §7)
findings.tier_evidence: FC1 Read of Class 0 static data succeeded without preceding g120 Authentication Request — proof SA is not enforced and every function code is reachable without a key.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 would be sending a control primitive (FC5 Direct Operate, FC13 Cold Restart). Destructive on live grid — trips protection relays. Recce correctly refuses.
findings.tester_next_step: TEST-CELL ONLY: dnp3ctl <ip>:20000 direct-operate --dst <addr> --group 12 --index 0 --code Latch-On — actuates a real binary output. Never on production. Read-only continuation: dnp3ctl read g30v1 --dst <addr> for analog inputs.

findings.title_pattern: DNP3 control-function surface exposed alongside missing SA
findings.tier_evidence: Emitted whenever class0_readable — protocol surface reachable, not proof of write.
findings.promotion_notes: Send FC5 Direct Operate against a canary binary output. DESTRUCTIVE, gate under --dnp3-write and only for test cells.
findings.tester_next_step: TEST-CELL ONLY: dnp3ctl <ip>:20000 direct-operate --dst 1 --group 12 --index 0 --code Pulse-On --on-time 100 — sends one CROB and inspects the ACK; never against live protection relays.

findings.promotion_notes: Add vendor→CVE map (SEL, GE Multilin, SICAM, SCADAPack, Motorola ACE) with per-firmware CVE bands.
findings.tester_next_step: Cross-reference vendor+firmware against ICSA feed (SEL RTAC, GE D400, Schneider SCADAPack, Siemens SICAM); check the RTU's web UI on 80/443 for default creds (SEL: 2AC/OTTER, SCADAPack: administrator/admin).

findings.tier_evidence: Learned from wire — not a vuln.
findings.promotion_notes: Feeds every follow-on request but is not a finding beyond info.
findings.tester_next_step: Use the disclosed source address as --dst on every subsequent dnp3ctl call; correlate address across scans to identify the same substation on a moved IP.

findings.title_pattern: DNP3 IIN flags indicate device restart / trouble / config state
findings.tier_evidence: IIN1/IIN2 bits directly parsed from the outstation reply — deterministic device state.
findings.promotion_notes: State observation, not a promotable primitive.
findings.tester_next_step: If device_restart set unexpectedly, ask the site engineer for the last commanded restart timestamp; if the bit predates that, someone else sent FC13/14 — pull SIEM logs.

findings.title_pattern: DNP3 outstation responds to broadcast address 0xFFFD
findings.tier_evidence: Reply to 0xFFFD broadcast Read proves broadcast-answer misconfig.
findings.promotion_notes: Config issue — no further probe safely available.
findings.tester_next_step: dnp3ctl <ip>:20000 read g60v1 --dst 0xFFFD — confirms; then work with engineer to disable broadcast-answer in the outstation config.

findings.title_pattern: DNP3 unsolicited responses observed on connect (misconfigured target)
findings.tier_evidence: UNS bit set frame delivered without any master registration — recce captured live event data pushed to whoever answered.
findings.promotion_notes: Passive: keep the socket open and log all event data → continuous process visibility from a rogue master. Ethical only in agreed engagement.
findings.tester_next_step: nc -l -k -p 20000 & then tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/dnp3.pcap 'port 20000'; parse with Wireshark DNP3 dissector; extract analog values / SOE events over time — full process visibility.

findings.tier_evidence: DNP3 UDP-mapped reply from the outstation — deterministic.
findings.promotion_notes: Same T2 promotion path as TCP variant — inherits no_secure_auth once class0_readable also true on UDP.
findings.tester_next_step: nmap -sU -p 20000 --script dnp3-info <ip>; craft spoofed-source UDP frames from an authorised source IP (lab only) to prove no-state-tracking.
Compare delay_ms across scans to detect network path changes or under-provisioned SCADA links.
